name: posthog-squad
description: Single-agent PostHog squad: daily digest (DAU/WAU/MAU, north-star, engaged + dying), activation-funnel debugger, mid-day anomaly alerts, weekly recap. Opt-in add-ons: release tracker + auto cohorts.
author: pancake-official

workflows.summary: Run the daily product-analytics digest: DAU/WAU/MAU, north-star event volume, engaged users, dying users.

inputs.date: ISO date (optional; defaults to yesterday in the pinned timezone)

workflows.outcome: Digest filed to wiki/Knowledge/PostHog/Reports/daily/YYYY-MM-DD.md and a 6-8 line summary posted on the board.

workflows.summary: Roll up the week's analytics — WoW deltas on north-star events, activation rate, watchlist movement.

inputs.week: ISO week, e.g. 2026-W24 (optional; defaults to the week just ended)

workflows.outcome: Recap filed to wiki/Knowledge/PostHog/Reports/weekly/YYYY-WW.md and summarized on the board.

workflows.summary: Debug the signup-to-activation funnel for a cohort window and name the biggest drop-off step.
workflows.outcome: Funnel analysis filed to wiki/Knowledge/PostHog/FunnelDebugger/YYYY-MM-DD.md with the top drop-off step + suspected cause on the board.

workflows.summary: Pull a requested set of PostHog metrics and publish them as a shareable report (wiki page or HTML preview).

inputs.metrics: what to pull, in plain language (e.g. "DAU last 7d, top 5 events, active users")

workflows.outcome: Report produced and filed (wiki path or signed preview URL returned on the board ticket).

required_vault_secrets.label: PostHog personal API key (read-only — Settings → Personal API keys → read access on Query, Insight, Event definition, Action, Person, Cohort)
SECOND PostHog API key, Cohort write ONLY. Powers the optional auto-cohort sync. Leave blank to skip — the squad still works fully without it. NEVER reuse the read-only key here.
